tools.title: Make

servers.name: Make MCP server
servers.capabilities: Run active and on-demand scenarios; view and modify scenarios, connections, webhooks, data stores, teams and organizations.

tools.notes: OAuth at mcp.make.com; API-key access uses https://<MAKE_ZONE>/mcp/v2 with a Bearer header. Management tools need a paid plan.

tools.title: n8n

servers.name: n8n instance-level MCP server

settings.name: n8n_host
settings.description: n8n: your n8n host, without https://

servers.capabilities: Search workflows, run MCP-enabled workflows, create and edit workflows and data tables, manage agents.

tools.notes: An instance owner or admin enables it in Settings > Instance-level MCP, which shows the exact URL; each workflow must be enabled for MCP. Cloud and self-hosted; features depend on n8n version (2.13+ to 2.36).

tools.title: Zapier
tools.summary: No-code automation across thousands of apps.

servers.name: Zapier MCP
servers.capabilities: Expose actions from 9,000+ connected apps (send emails, create tasks, update records, search data) as MCP tools.

tools.notes: Each successful tool call uses two Zapier tasks from the plan. Clients without OAuth use a token-based server created at mcp.zapier.com.
